If a stain is done, ask for an H-score rather than a positive or negative call, so it can be read against the published subtype distribution.
Expect a sponsor to re-test centrally regardless of the local result.
geographic_scope: Limited to academic and sponsor central laboratories; not a routine US reference-laboratory order
notes: No target_validator row exists for this stain, which is itself the finding: it is not a standard clinical order.

intervention_label: HLA class I genotyping at 4-digit (allele-level) resolution
access_summary: A blood draw, widely available through transplant and immunogenetics laboratories, and the gate on an entire class of agents. It decides whether any peptide-HLA-directed therapy, tebentafusp-like ImmTACs or MAGE-A4, NY-ESO-1 and PRAME TCR-T products, is discussable at all, and it stops money being spent on antigen stains that cannot be interpreted without it. Order it before the reflex expression assays, not alongside them.
regulatory_status: Standard CLIA and ASHI-accredited immunogenetics testing

manufacturer.company: Mayo Clinic Laboratories (preferred by the target_validator); HistoGenetics; Versiti Diagnostic Laboratories; Labcorp; Quest Diagnostics
manufacturer.notes: No phone number for these providers was verified live in this pass; Mayo Clinic Laboratories returned HTTP 403. Most transplant centres and large hospitals have an in-house or contracted HLA laboratory, which is usually the fastest route. Ask specifically for 4-digit allele-level typing, since 2-digit resolution will not answer the A*02:01 question.

payer_access_notes: HLA typing ordered outside a transplant context is sometimes questioned by payers. Framing the order as eligibility screening for HLA-restricted cell therapy usually resolves it; the test is inexpensive if paid privately.
next_steps: Order 4-digit class I typing on blood; no tumour tissue is consumed.
State allele-level resolution on the requisition explicitly.
Hold the MAGE-A4, NY-ESO-1 and PRAME expression reflexes until the type is back, and drop them if she is not HLA-A*02:01.
If she is HLA-A*02:01, ask a sarcoma centre which peptide-HLA-directed protocols accept bone-sarcoma primaries.
geographic_scope: US clinical immunogenetics laboratories; widely available
notes: Distinct from tumour HLA class I expression by immunohistochemistry, which asks a different question and is not a standard clinical order.

intervention_label: Measured ECOG, baseline echocardiogram and ECG, organ-function labs, RECIST baseline imaging
access_summary: All four are ordinary clinic items with no access barrier at all, and together they are what open or close most of the rest of this guide. The ECOG in the file is an assumption, not a measurement, and it is the single criterion that most often decides trial eligibility: NCT05039801 and NCT04040205 require 0-1, TAPUR and NCT06176989 allow 0-2, NCT04433221 uses Karnofsky 50% or better. The echocardiogram gates the anthracycline, the labs gate ifosfamide and cisplatin, and the CT gates every response assessment downstream.
regulatory_status: Not applicable

manufacturer.company: Not applicable
manufacturer.notes: All performed by the treating institution.

payer_access_notes: Standard pre-treatment assessments in a newly diagnosed metastatic cancer; covered without argument. The only real cost is time, and in an aggressive tumour that cost is not trivial.
next_steps: Have ECOG scored and written in the notes at the next visit, alongside pain and weight-bearing status, and repeat it after any orthopaedic intervention that improves mobility.
Order the echocardiogram with LVEF (or MUGA) and a 12-lead ECG before the first anthracycline dose.
Draw CBC with differential and a comprehensive metabolic panel, with renal function documented if ifosfamide or cisplatin is planned.
Get contrast-enhanced CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis with thin-section lung imaging, and have measurable lesions identified for RECIST.
Ask explicitly whether orthopaedic stabilisation would improve the performance status, since a better measured ECOG reopens the protocols that require 0-1.
geographic_scope: Available at any treating institution
notes: Worth stating plainly: performance status of 2 or worse was independently associated with shorter PFS in the French Sarcoma Group cohort, so measuring it is prognostic information and not only an eligibility formality.
